class.DUELIST.description: Strength and dexterity: melee, block and attack speed
class.DUELIST.name: Duelist

Life leech
Block and attack speed

Average defence against magic
Needs gear

Evasion and speed
Ranged combat
Fast farming
class.SCION.description: All-rounder: exactly twenty of each attribute and a way into any branch of the tree
class.SCION.name: Scion

Access to the whole tree
Even attributes
Any archetype
class.SCION.cons:
No specialisation of her own
For experienced players

Evasion

Armour and energy shield
Healing
High resistances
class.TEMPLAR.cons:
Average damage
Slow to ramp up

class.WITCH.name: Witch

item.FIRE_FLUX.description: A fire additive: the smith adds fire damage
item.FIRE_FLUX.name: Fire Flux
item.FRACTURING_ORB.description: Fractures a random affix of a rare item with 4+ affixes (a crafted one only if nothing else): orbs no longer remove or reroll it. One fractured affix per item. On a pet it fractures a random line.
item.FRACTURING_ORB.name: Fracturing Orb
item.FROST_FLUX.description: A frost additive: the smith adds cold damage
item.FROST_FLUX.name: Frost Flux
item.GHOST_ASH_LOG.description: A white ash, cold as a ghost
item.GHOST_ASH_LOG.name: Ghost Ash Log
item.GLOWCAP.description: A mushroom that glows in the dark
item.GLOWCAP.name: Glowcap
item.IRONWOOD_LOG.name: Ironwood Log
item.IRON_ORE.description: Heavy ore that weapons are forged from
item.IRON_ORE.name: Iron Ore
item.MIRROR_OF_KALANDRA.description: Creates an exact copy of an item; the copy is mirrored and no orb or essence can change it. The original is untouched. Not for flasks, corrupted or mirrored items.
item.MIRROR_OF_KALANDRA.name: Mirror of Kalandra
item.MITHRIL_ORE.description: A light metal that never tarnishes
item.MITHRIL_ORE.name: Mithril Ore
item.MOON_LOTUS.description: A lotus that blooms under the moon
item.MOON_LOTUS.name: Moon Lotus
item.OAK_LOG.name: Oak Log
item.ORB_OF_ALCHEMY.description: Turns a normal (white) item or pet rare with random affixes — from the rare minimum up to one below the cap; the last one comes from Exalted Orbs or crafting. On a map — adds a random alchemy line (more packs, magic and rare monsters, loot, chests, gold, boss power, crystals or books), up to three different ones. With an Omen of Choice — three options to pick from.
item.ORB_OF_ALCHEMY.name: Orb of Alchemy
item.ORB_OF_ALTERATION.description: Rerolls the affixes of a magic item; a fractured affix and implicits stay. Works on flasks, tools, maps and pets (a magic pet's lines).
item.ORB_OF_ALTERATION.name: Orb of Alteration
item.ORB_OF_ANNULMENT.description: Removes a random non-fractured affix from a magic or rare item or pet; not applied if it is already at its rarity minimum.
item.ORB_OF_ANNULMENT.name: Orb of Annulment
item.ORB_OF_AUGMENTATION.description: Adds a random affix to a magic item that still has a free prefix or suffix. Works on flasks, tools and pets (a line on a magic pet, up to its cap).
item.ORB_OF_AUGMENTATION.name: Orb of Augmentation
item.ORB_OF_CHANCE.description: Gives a normal (white) item a random rarity with affixes; with a small chance it becomes a unique of the same slot, no higher than the base level. A normal pet turns magic or rare. Works on flasks too.
item.ORB_OF_CHANCE.name: Orb of Chance
item.ORB_OF_REGRET.description: Refunds one allocated node of the passive tree or the Atlas; the point can be spent again.
item.ORB_OF_REGRET.name: Orb of Regret
item.ORB_OF_SCOURING.description: Strips all affixes and makes the item or pet normal (magic if it keeps a fractured affix); implicits stay, unique and mythical items are not accepted. A map is never normal: it becomes magic with one random affix. Works on flasks too.
item.ORB_OF_SCOURING.name: Orb of Scouring
item.ORB_OF_TRANSMUTATION.description: Turns a normal (white) item magic with 1–2 random affixes. Works on flasks, tools and pets (a normal pet turns magic).
item.ORB_OF_TRANSMUTATION.name: Orb of Transmutation
item.QUICK_FLUX.description: A quicksilver additive: the smith adds attack speed
item.QUICK_FLUX.name: Quick Flux
item.REGAL_ORB.description: Turns a magic item rare: its affixes stay and one more random affix is added (plus any missing up to the rare minimum). A magic pet turns rare the same way.
item.REGAL_ORB.name: Regal Orb
item.RUBY.description: A crimson stone, warm even in the dark
item.RUBY.name: Ruby
item.SAPPHIRE.description: A blue stone that keeps the cold
item.SAPPHIRE.name: Sapphire
item.SHADEBLOOM.description: A flower that opens only in shade
item.SHADEBLOOM.name: Shadebloom
item.SHAPERS_ORB.description: A rare item without influence gains Shaper influence and a modifier from its pool (needs a free slot); a rare tool gains a Shaper work line. A map becomes Shaper-held, its lines untouched.
item.SHAPERS_ORB.name: Shaper's Orb
item.SILVER_ORE.description: Pale ore, cold to the touch
item.SILVER_ORE.name: Silver Ore
item.STONE_FLUX.description: A stone additive: the smith adds armour
item.STONE_FLUX.name: Stone Flux
item.STONE_POLISHED.name: Polished Stone
item.STONE_ROUGH.name: Rough Stone
item.STORM_FLUX.description: A storm additive: the smith adds lightning damage
item.STORM_FLUX.name: Storm Flux
item.TOPAZ.description: A yellow stone from deep deposits
item.TOPAZ.name: Topaz
item.VAAL_ORB.description: Corrupts an item, map or pet for good — no orb can change it afterwards. Equally likely: nothing; the implicit is replaced by a corrupted line (a special work line on a tool); a reroll into a rare (not on unique, mythical items or flasks); or every affix value ×0.8–1.2, past the tier cap. A pet: nothing, one line at its top value or a reroll of its lines. Works on flasks too.
item.VAAL_ORB.name: Vaal Orb
item.VOID_ROOT.description: A root that grows out of nothing
item.VOID_ROOT.name: Void Root
item.WOOD_LOG.name: Wooden Log
item.WORMWOOD.description: A bitter weed of the roadsides
item.WORMWOOD.name: Wormwood
item.YEW_LOG.name: Yew Log

map.C1_BLACK_CAUSEWAY.description: A log road over the bog that sinks with every step.
map.C1_BLACK_CAUSEWAY.name: Black Causeway
map.C1_BRINE_CAVES.description: Grottoes where the tide drives everything, living or not.
map.C1_BRINE_CAVES.name: Brine Caves
map.C1_CHIEFTAINS_BARROW.description: The burial mound of an ancient chieftain and his sworn guard.
map.C1_CHIEFTAINS_BARROW.name: Chieftain's Barrow
map.C1_CRYPT_OF_EXILES.description: The resting place of those who came here before you.
map.C1_CRYPT_OF_EXILES.name: Crypt of Exiles
map.C1_DROWNED_LIGHTHOUSE.description: The lighthouse still burns, but now it calls the dead.
map.C1_DROWNED_LIGHTHOUSE.name: Drowned Lighthouse
map.C1_FALLEN_RUINS.description: A fallen fortress still held by its garrison.
map.C1_FALLEN_RUINS.name: Fallen Ruins
map.C1_GULL_CLIFFS.description: Cliffs above the surf where things larger than gulls make their nests.
map.C1_GULL_CLIFFS.name: Gull Cliffs
map.C1_MISTY_FERRY.description: A ferry crosses the mist, and no one pays for the way back.
map.C1_MISTY_FERRY.name: Misty Ferry
map.C1_OLD_OUTPOST.description: A border fort whose garrison still stands its watch.
map.C1_OLD_OUTPOST.name: Old Outpost
map.C1_ROTTING_MIRE.description: A bog where the dead do not lie still.
map.C1_ROTTING_MIRE.name: Rotting Mire
map.C1_SHIP_GRAVEYARD.description: Hulls run aground and crews that never made it ashore.
map.C1_SHIP_GRAVEYARD.name: Ship Graveyard
map.C1_SMUGGLERS_GROTTO.description: A hidden cove where the loot is shared out with knives.
map.C1_SMUGGLERS_GROTTO.name: Smugglers' Grotto
map.C1_TIDAL_SHORE.description: Wet sand, broken hulls and those the sea would not let go.
map.C1_TIDAL_SHORE.name: Tidal Shore
map.C1_WHISPERING_WOOD.description: A forest where wolves and spiders hunt and the trees watch you pass.
map.C1_WHISPERING_WOOD.name: Whispering Wood
map.C1_WOLF_THICKET.description: A windfall thicket where the howling never stops, even by day.
map.C1_WOLF_THICKET.name: Wolf Thicket
map.C2_ABYSSAL_STAIR.description: Steps hewn downward, toward whatever prays in the dark.
map.C2_ABYSSAL_STAIR.name: Abyssal Stair
map.C2_ASHEN_WASTES.description: A scorched plain under a smouldering sky.
map.C2_ASHEN_WASTES.name: Ashen Wastes
map.C2_CINDER_CITADEL.description: A fortress that burned years ago and never quite burned out.
map.C2_CINDER_CITADEL.name: Cinder Citadel
map.C2_CRYSTAL_MINES.description: Mines where the stone crackles with lightning.
map.C2_CRYSTAL_MINES.name: Crystal Mines
map.C2_DEEP_ADITS.description: Adits deeper than any chart, where the ore itself begins to move.
map.C2_DEEP_ADITS.name: Deep Adits
map.C2_DROWNED_TEMPLE.description: A sanctuary that sank beneath the waves with its priests.
map.C2_DROWNED_TEMPLE.name: Drowned Temple
map.C2_EMBER_FIELDS.description: Fields where the ash never cools and the hounds never sleep.
map.C2_EMBER_FIELDS.name: Ember Fields
map.C2_FOOTHILL_ROAD.description: An old road into the mountains where snow buries the hunters' tracks.
map.C2_FOOTHILL_ROAD.name: Foothill Road
map.C2_FROSTFANG_GLACIER.description: A tongue of ice beneath which sleeps a wyrm older than the ridge.
map.C2_FROSTFANG_GLACIER.name: Frostfang Glacier
map.C2_FROZEN_PASS.description: A mountain path where the cold kills faster than a blade.
map.C2_FROZEN_PASS.name: Frozen Pass
map.C2_GEODE_HOLLOW.description: A cave lined with crystals where something stirs within.
map.C2_GEODE_HOLLOW.name: Geode Hollow
map.C2_GLACIER_TOMBS.description: Ancient tombs frozen into the glacier along with their masters.
map.C2_GLACIER_TOMBS.name: Glacier Tombs
map.C2_MINERS_VILLAGE.description: A village at the mouth of the mines: the miners went deep and came back changed.
map.C2_MINERS_VILLAGE.name: Miners' Village
map.C2_OBSIDIAN_QUARRY.description: A quarry where black glass and monsters are hewn from cooled lava.
map.C2_OBSIDIAN_QUARRY.name: Obsidian Quarry
map.C2_SLAG_PITS.description: Pits of molten slag where something lives.
map.C2_SLAG_PITS.name: Slag Pits
map.C2_STORM_PEAK.description: A summit struck by lightning more often than the ground below.
map.C2_STORM_PEAK.name: Storm Peak
map.C2_SUNKEN_SHRINE.description: A mountain lake swallowed the shrine but could not silence its priests.
map.C2_SUNKEN_SHRINE.name: Sunken Shrine
map.C2_TROLL_CAVES.description: A lair of mountain trolls strewn with the bones of unlucky travellers.
map.C2_TROLL_CAVES.name: Troll Caves
map.C3_BURIED_CITY.description: Rooftops jut from the sand, and the streets beneath are still full of residents.
map.C3_BURIED_CITY.name: Buried City
map.C3_CARAVAN_ROAD.description: An old trade road where the sand buries wagons along with their drivers.
map.C3_CARAVAN_ROAD.name: Caravan Road
map.C3_DRY_RIVERBED.description: The bed of a river that sank underground, and the beasts that followed it.
map.C3_DRY_RIVERBED.name: Dry Riverbed
map.C3_EMBALMERS_HALL.description: Here the dead were prepared for eternity, and some preparations are unfinished.
map.C3_EMBALMERS_HALL.name: Embalmers' Hall
map.C3_GLASS_DESERT.description: Sand fused to glass by some ancient fire, cutting soles and blinding eyes.
map.C3_GLASS_DESERT.name: Glass Desert
map.C3_MIRAGE_VALE.description: Here you see what is not there, and miss what is.
map.C3_MIRAGE_VALE.name: Mirage Vale
map.C3_RAIDER_CAMP.description: Tents among the rocks where the spoils are shared and the knives honed for the next.
map.C3_RAIDER_CAMP.name: Raider Camp
map.C3_RED_GORGE.description: A narrow pass between scarlet cliffs where the echo carries footsteps long before the foe.
map.C3_RED_GORGE.name: Red Gorge
map.C3_SALT_FLATS.description: A white crust of salt to the horizon, and tracks that end in the middle of the plain.
map.C3_SALT_FLATS.name: Salt Flats
map.C3_SANDSTONE_ARCH.description: A stone bridge carved by the wind, walked only by the boldest.
map.C3_SANDSTONE_ARCH.name: Sandstone Arch
map.C3_SCORPION_NEST.description: The cracks in the rock rustle with a hundred legs the moment you draw near.
map.C3_SCORPION_NEST.name: Scorpion Nest
map.C3_SINGING_DUNES.description: The dunes hum in the wind, and in the hum are the voices of the lost.
map.C3_SINGING_DUNES.name: Singing Dunes
map.C3_STORM_MESA.description: A table mountain above which the sandstorm never rests for an hour.
map.C3_STORM_MESA.name: Storm Mesa
map.C3_SUN_KINGS_PYRAMID.description: Beneath the peak of the pyramid sleeps the one who ruled the sands, and his sleep is light.
map.C3_SUN_KINGS_PYRAMID.name: The Sun King's Pyramid
map.C3_SUN_TEMPLE.description: A golden temple where priests prayed to the sun until it answered.
map.C3_SUN_TEMPLE.name: Temple of the Sun
map.C3_TOMBS_OF_KINGS.description: The resting places of ancient kings, whose guards do not know the age has ended.
map.C3_TOMBS_OF_KINGS.name: Tombs of Kings
map.C3_VULTURE_ROOST.description: Ledges over the abyss where the birds wait for a traveller to slip.
map.C3_VULTURE_ROOST.name: Vulture Roost
map.C3_WITHERED_OASIS.description: The palms withered long ago, and the well water turned bitter as poison.
map.C3_WITHERED_OASIS.name: Withered Oasis
map.C4_AMBER_TUNNELS.description: Sticky corridors where those who came before you are frozen in amber.
map.C4_AMBER_TUNNELS.name: Amber Tunnels
map.C4_BROOD_CHAMBERS.description: Warm chambers where the hive's next generation ripens.
map.C4_BROOD_CHAMBERS.name: Brood Chambers
map.C4_FLOODED_THICKET.description: A forest waist-deep in water where every log might be a maw.
map.C4_FLOODED_THICKET.name: Flooded Thicket
map.C4_FUNGAL_LOWLANDS.description: Mushrooms taller than trees, and spores that take root in the lungs.
map.C4_FUNGAL_LOWLANDS.name: Fungal Lowlands
map.C4_GREAT_TREE.description: A tree whose crown could hold a city, and something lives in it.
map.C4_GREAT_TREE.name: The Great Tree
map.C4_HIVE_HEART.description: The core of the hive, where the queen commands thousands upon thousands.
map.C4_HIVE_HEART.name: Heart of the Hive
map.C4_JUNGLE_EDGE.description: A wall of leaves beyond which the path vanishes at the first step.
map.C4_JUNGLE_EDGE.name: Jungle's Edge
map.C4_LOST_EXPEDITION.description: Tents, journals and not a single soul, only tracks leading into the thicket.
map.C4_LOST_EXPEDITION.name: Lost Expedition Camp
map.C4_MANGROVE_DELTA.description: Roots rise from the water like ribs, and something breathes beneath them.
map.C4_MANGROVE_DELTA.name: Mangrove Delta
map.C4_MANTIS_GARDENS.description: Abandoned gardens where the mantises pray only to hunger.
map.C4_MANTIS_GARDENS.name: Mantis Gardens
map.C4_ORCHID_GLADE.description: The flowers smell so sweet that travellers fall asleep and never wake.
map.C4_ORCHID_GLADE.name: Orchid Glade
map.C4_OVERGROWN_ROAD.description: The paving of an empire that fell so long ago the forest forgot it.
map.C4_OVERGROWN_ROAD.name: Overgrown Road
map.C4_PANTHER_TRAIL.description: A game trail where the hunter swiftly becomes the prey.
map.C4_PANTHER_TRAIL.name: Panther Trail
map.C4_ROYAL_COMBS.description: Combs brimming with royal jelly, and guards who know no fear.
map.C4_ROYAL_COMBS.name: Royal Combs
map.C4_SERPENT_SHRINE.description: Stone serpents on the walls, and living ones at the altar's foot.
map.C4_SERPENT_SHRINE.name: Serpent Shrine
map.C4_STRANGLER_GROVE.description: Here the vines strangle more than trees.
map.C4_STRANGLER_GROVE.name: Strangler Grove
map.C4_WASP_HOLLOW.description: Paper nests the size of houses, and a drone that makes the ground shake.
map.C4_WASP_HOLLOW.name: Wasp Hollow
map.C4_WEEPING_CANOPY.description: The leaves drip without end, and it is not always rain.
map.C4_WEEPING_CANOPY.name: Weeping Canopy
map.C5_ASHFALL_VALLEY.description: Ash falls like snow, and whole villages lie buried beneath it.
map.C5_ASHFALL_VALLEY.name: Ashfall Valley
map.C5_BRIMSTONE_MINES.description: Mines where brimstone was dug until the brimstone began digging men.
map.C5_BRIMSTONE_MINES.name: Brimstone Mines
map.C5_BURNING_BARRACKS.description: The barracks have burned for a hundred years, and the soldiers never woke.
map.C5_BURNING_BARRACKS.name: Burning Barracks
map.C5_CALDERA_LAKE.description: A lake of boiling water in the bowl of a volcano that is dormant, for now.
map.C5_CALDERA_LAKE.name: Caldera Lake
map.C5_CINDER_WASTES.description: The land is burned black, but something upon it still smoulders and moves.
map.C5_CINDER_WASTES.name: Cinder Wastes
map.C5_DRAGONS_VENT.description: A vent spewing flame that seems almost like breath.
map.C5_DRAGONS_VENT.name: Dragon's Vent
map.C5_FLAME_CITADEL.description: A stronghold where a throne of cooled lava was raised, and fire itself was seated upon it.
map.C5_FLAME_CITADEL.name: Citadel of Flame
map.C5_FRONTIER_FORT.description: The last bulwark before the fire, and its garrison long since changed sides.
map.C5_FRONTIER_FORT.name: Frontier Fort
map.C5_INFERNAL_GATE.description: The citadel gates, beyond which rings the laughter of those who called the fire.
map.C5_INFERNAL_GATE.name: Infernal Gate
map.C5_LAVA_FIELDS.description: A black crust over a river of fire that cracks with every step.
map.C5_LAVA_FIELDS.name: Lava Fields
map.C5_MAGMA_RIVER.description: A river of molten stone, and a ferryman who takes his fare in blood.
map.C5_MAGMA_RIVER.name: Magma River
map.C5_MOLTEN_CORE.description: The mountain's heart, where the stone flows and the air burns.
map.C5_MOLTEN_CORE.name: Molten Core
map.C5_OBSIDIAN_SPIRES.description: Needles of black glass taller than towers, each reflecting the flame.
map.C5_OBSIDIAN_SPIRES.name: Obsidian Spires
map.C5_OUTER_WALLS.description: The citadel's walls, blackened by fire, yet never fallen.
map.C5_OUTER_WALLS.name: Outer Walls
map.C5_SCORCHED_FOOTHILLS.description: Slopes split with cracks that weep smoke and heat.
map.C5_SCORCHED_FOOTHILLS.name: Scorched Foothills
map.C5_SIEGE_CAMP.description: The camp of an army besieging the citadel so long it has forgotten why.
map.C5_SIEGE_CAMP.name: Siege Camp
map.C5_SMELTERY.description: The furnaces here have not gone out in centuries, and they are not fed with coal.
map.C5_SMELTERY.name: The Smeltery
map.C5_WAR_FORGES.description: Forges where the citadel's weapons are made from what remains of its foes.
map.C5_WAR_FORGES.name: War Forges
map.C6_ABYSSAL_THRONE.description: At the bottom of all things, in a darkness without end, sits the one the abyss itself worships.
map.C6_ABYSSAL_THRONE.name: Throne of the Abyss
map.C6_BLIGHTED_FIELDS.description: The harvest rotted where it stood, and the rot moved on, into people.
map.C6_BLIGHTED_FIELDS.name: Blighted Fields
map.C6_CATACOMB_MAW.description: The catacombs lead down and down until they end in someone's throat.
map.C6_CATACOMB_MAW.name: Catacomb Maw
map.C6_ECLIPSE_ALTAR.description: An altar where the sun goes dark each time blood is spilled.
map.C6_ECLIPSE_ALTAR.name: Eclipse Altar
map.C6_ENDLESS_STAIR.description: The steps lead down further than the living can descend.
map.C6_ENDLESS_STAIR.name: Endless Stair
map.C6_FALLEN_STAR.description: A crater where something fell that shone, but was never a star.
map.C6_FALLEN_STAR.name: Fallen Star
map.C6_FORSAKEN_ABBEY.description: The monks prayed the abyss would not notice them. It did.
map.C6_FORSAKEN_ABBEY.name: Forsaken Abbey
map.C6_OSSUARY.description: The walls are built of bones, and some bones still remember who they were.
map.C6_OSSUARY.name: The Ossuary
map.C6_PLAGUE_VILLAGE.description: The houses are boarded up from inside, yet the knocking comes from without.
map.C6_PLAGUE_VILLAGE.name: Plague Village
map.C6_RIFT_EDGE.description: The land breaks off into the void, and the void looks back.
map.C6_RIFT_EDGE.name: Rift's Edge
map.C6_ROTTEN_HEART.description: The whole plague grows from a single place, and it beats.
map.C6_ROTTEN_HEART.name: The Rotten Heart
map.C6_ROTTING_ORCHARD.description: The apples fall and burst, and it is not worms that crawl out.
map.C6_ROTTING_ORCHARD.name: Rotting Orchard
map.C6_SPORE_CATHEDRAL.description: A cathedral overgrown with mycelium, where the choir sings in spores.
map.C6_SPORE_CATHEDRAL.name: Spore Cathedral
map.C6_STARLESS_DEEP.description: A darkness so thick the torchlight sticks in it like pitch.
map.C6_STARLESS_DEEP.name: Starless Deep
map.C6_VEIL_OF_SHADOWS.description: The thin line between the world and the abyss, worn through to holes.
map.C6_VEIL_OF_SHADOWS.name: Veil of Shadows
map.C6_VOID_SHORE.description: The surf here is black and silent, and it carries away more than sand.
map.C6_VOID_SHORE.name: Void Shore
map.C6_WHISPERING_CHASM.description: Whispers rise from the depths, and they know your name.
map.C6_WHISPERING_CHASM.name: Whispering Chasm
map.C6_WITHERED_WOOD.description: Leafless trees reach toward the traveller as if begging for help.
map.C6_WITHERED_WOOD.name: Withered Wood
map.C7_SKY_LANDING.name: Sky Landing
map.C7_SKY_LANDING.description: The last stair of the Abyss opens onto open sky.
map.C7_GLASS_DUNES.name: Glass Dunes
map.C7_GLASS_DUNES.description: Sand fused by falling stars crunches like ice.
map.C7_THUNDER_STEPS.name: Thunder Steps
map.C7_THUNDER_STEPS.description: Every step up the mountain is answered by thunder.
map.C7_BROKEN_BRIDGE.name: Broken Bridge
map.C7_BROKEN_BRIDGE.description: Half a bridge hangs over a sky with no bottom.
map.C7_MIRROR_FLATS.name: Mirror Flats
map.C7_MIRROR_FLATS.description: The ground reflects a sky that is not there.
map.C7_LIGHTNING_SPIRE.name: Lightning Spire
map.C7_LIGHTNING_SPIRE.description: A needle of rock that drinks the storm.
map.C7_WIND_TEMPLE.name: Temple of Winds
map.C7_WIND_TEMPLE.description: Its bells have rung by themselves for a thousand years.
map.C7_SHATTERED_CROWN.name: Shattered Crown
map.C7_SHATTERED_CROWN.description: A ring of glass spires around a dead crater.
map.C7_CLOUD_CITADEL.name: Cloud Citadel
map.C7_CLOUD_CITADEL.description: A fortress built on clouds that have not moved in ages.
map.C7_STORMWALL.name: Stormwall
map.C7_STORMWALL.description: The wind here is a wall, and the wall has teeth.
map.C7_PRISM_CANYON.name: Prism Canyon
map.C7_PRISM_CANYON.description: Light breaks into colours no eye should see.
map.C7_FALLEN_ORRERY.name: Fallen Orrery
map.C7_FALLEN_ORRERY.description: The heavens’ own machine, broken on the ground.
map.C7_EYE_OF_THE_STORM.name: Eye of the Storm
map.C7_EYE_OF_THE_STORM.description: Silence, at the centre of everything that screams.
map.C7_SINGING_GLASS.name: Singing Glass
map.C7_SINGING_GLASS.description: The wind plays the dunes like an organ.
map.C7_SHATTERED_THRONE.name: Throne of the Broken Sky
map.C7_SHATTERED_THRONE.description: Here the sky was broken, and here it is ruled.
map.C8_SUNKEN_GATE.name: Sunken Gate
map.C8_SUNKEN_GATE.description: The empire’s front gate, under forty fathoms of water.
map.C8_CORAL_GARDENS.name: Coral Gardens
map.C8_CORAL_GARDENS.description: The gardens still bloom, in colours of bone and blood.
map.C8_TIDE_VAULTS.name: Tide Vaults
map.C8_TIDE_VAULTS.description: Where the empire kept its water, and its secrets.
map.C8_DROWNED_FORUM.name: Drowned Forum
map.C8_DROWNED_FORUM.description: Speeches are still made here, by the dead.
map.C8_PEARL_REEF.name: Pearl Reef
map.C8_PEARL_REEF.description: Every pearl here was once a sailor’s eye.
map.C8_FLOODED_AQUEDUCT.name: Flooded Aqueduct
map.C8_FLOODED_AQUEDUCT.description: The water flows uphill now, towards the throne.
map.C8_LEGION_BARRACKS.name: Legion Barracks
map.C8_LEGION_BARRACKS.description: The legion never left its post. It only drowned.
map.C8_KELP_CATHEDRAL.name: Kelp Cathedral
map.C8_KELP_CATHEDRAL.description: Hymns to a sea god echo under the waves.
map.C8_SEALED_CISTERN.name: Sealed Cistern
map.C8_SEALED_CISTERN.description: Something was sealed in with the water.
map.C8_SUNKEN_MARKET.name: Sunken Market
map.C8_SUNKEN_MARKET.description: The stalls still hold goods that nobody will buy.
map.C8_BLEACHED_ATOLL.name: Bleached Atoll
map.C8_BLEACHED_ATOLL.description: The reef died white, and the dead reef hungers.
map.C8_TIDAL_ENGINE.name: Tidal Engine
map.C8_TIDAL_ENGINE.description: The empire moved the sea with this. It still turns.
map.C8_IMPERIAL_BATHS.name: Imperial Baths
map.C8_ABYSSAL_TRENCH.name: Abyssal Trench
map.C8_ABYSSAL_TRENCH.description: The light gives up long before the bottom.
map.C8_DROWNED_THRONE.name: The Drowned Throne
map.C8_DROWNED_THRONE.description: The emperor still sits here, and still wears his crown.
map.C9_GODS_THRESHOLD.name: Threshold of the Gods
map.C9_GODS_THRESHOLD.description: No mortal was meant to stand here. You stand here.
map.C9_ASTRAL_SHORE.name: Astral Shore
map.C9_ASTRAL_SHORE.description: Stars wash up on this beach like shells.
map.C9_FIELDS_OF_OBLIVION.name: Fields of Oblivion
map.C9_FIELDS_OF_OBLIVION.description: Walk too long and you forget why you came.
map.C9_HALL_OF_JUDGEMENT.name: Hall of Judgement
map.C9_HALL_OF_JUDGEMENT.description: Every soul was weighed here. Most were found wanting.
map.C9_CONSTELLATION_BRIDGE.name: Constellation Bridge
map.C9_CONSTELLATION_BRIDGE.description: A bridge of stars, and every star a god’s eye.
map.C9_NAMELESS_ARCHIVE.name: Nameless Archive
map.C9_NAMELESS_ARCHIVE.description: Books of everything that was forgotten.
map.C9_SUNFORGE.name: The Sunforge
map.C9_SUNFORGE.description: The gods forged the sun here, and left the fire burning.
map.C9_ASTRAL_ORCHARD.name: Astral Orchard
map.C9_HOLLOW_PANTHEON.name: Hollow Pantheon
map.C9_HOLLOW_PANTHEON.description: The statues are here. The gods are not.
map.C9_HALL_OF_WAR.name: Hall of War
map.C9_HALL_OF_WAR.description: The god of war still trains his chosen.
map.C9_STARLESS_VOID.name: Starless Void
map.C9_STARLESS_VOID.description: Here even the stars have been forgotten.
map.C9_CELESTIAL_OBSERVATORY.name: Celestial Observatory
map.C9_CELESTIAL_OBSERVATORY.description: From here the gods watched us. Now we watch them.
map.C9_THRONE_ROAD.name: Throne Road
map.C9_THRONE_ROAD.description: Paved with the crowns of kings who came before.
map.C9_EDGE_OF_NOTHING.name: Edge of Nothing
map.C9_EDGE_OF_NOTHING.description: Beyond this point, nothing. Not even darkness.
map.C9_LAST_THRONE.name: The Last Throne
map.C9_LAST_THRONE.description: One throne, one god, one exile. Only one leaves.

enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CHARGE_DURA: How much longer Frenzy, Power and Endurance Charges last than the base 10 s.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_FLASKS_AUTO: Every flask you carry is drunk at the start of each fight without spending Charges.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_HIGHEST_RES: Damage taken of the element you resist most.
Elemental Damage taken is mitigated by your highest Elemental Resistance.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_IGNITE_AS_C: Your Ignites deal Chaos Damage instead of Fire.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_LEECH_TO_SH: Life Leech restores Energy Shield instead of Life.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_LIFE_DAMAGE: Seconds over which delayed Life damage is dealt.
Share of damage to Life that is dealt to you over time instead of at once.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_LOWEST_RESI: Your damage of the element you resist least penetrates this much Resistance.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_LUCKY_CRIT: Critical Strike chance is rolled twice, the better roll counts.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_MANA_BEFORE: Share of damage taken that is removed from Mana before Life.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_MAX_ENDURAN: Endurance Charges you can hold above the base 3. Each: +2% Physical Damage Reduction and +2% to all Elemental Resistances.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_MAX_FRENZY_: Frenzy Charges you can hold above the base 3. Each: 2% increased Attack and Cast Speed and 2% more Damage.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_MAX_POWER_C: Power Charges you can hold above the base 3. Each: 20% increased Critical Strike Chance.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_NON_CRIT_DA: More or less damage of hits that are not Critical Strikes.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PET_ARMOR: Armour added to your combat pet.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PET_ATTACK_: Increased attack speed of your combat pet.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PET_DAMAGE: Increased damage of your combat pet.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PET_HEALTH: Increased maximum Life of your combat pet.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PET_LEVEL: Levels added to your combat pet in battle.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PET_LIFE: Maximum Life added to your combat pet.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PET_RESIST: Added to all Elemental Resistances of your combat pet.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PHYSICAL_TA: Share of Physical Damage from hits that you take as Cold Damage.
Share of Physical Damage from hits that you take as Fire Damage.
Share of Physical Damage from hits that you take as Lightning Damage.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RANDOM_ELEM: Each of your hits deals all of its damage as one random element.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SHIELD_DEGE: Percent of maximum Energy Shield lost per second.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_STRENGTH: Core attribute. Every 2 Strength grants +1 Life and every 5 grants 1% increased Physical Damage; also required to equip items.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_AGILITY: Core attribute. Each point of Dexterity grants +1 Evasion Rating; also required to equip items.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_INTELLECT: Core attribute. Every 2 Intelligence grants +1 Mana and every 5 grants 1% increased Energy Shield; also required to equip items.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ALL_ATTRIBU: Adds to Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence at once.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_HEALTH: Maximum Life. When Life reaches zero, the hero dies.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_MANA: Maximum Mana, the resource spent to use skills. Auras reserve part of it.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ENERGY: The hero's Energy pool, an extra resource spent and restored by certain skills and effects.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ENERGY_SHIE: A barrier over Life that absorbs hit damage first and recharges over time. Chaos Damage bypasses Energy Shield.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ARMOR: Reduces physical damage taken from hits. Works best against small hits; reduction is capped at 75%, and Maximum Physical Reduction raises the cap up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_EVASION: Grants a chance to fully evade attacks. Higher-level enemies need more Evasion to dodge; the chance is capped at 50%, and Maximum Evasion raises the cap up to 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_BLOCK_CHANC: Chance to block a hit and take no damage from it. Capped at 50%; Maximum Block raises the cap up to 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_STUN_THRESH: Raises the stun threshold: a hit must deal more damage to stun you.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SPELL_BLOCK: Chance to block spell damage; adds to the block chance.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PHYSICAL_RE: Percentage by which all physical damage taken is reduced, on top of Armour. Capped at 75%; Maximum Physical Reduction raises the cap up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_AVOID_STUN: Chance to avoid being stunned by a hit that would otherwise stun you.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_FIRE: Reduces Fire Damage taken by this percentage. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Fire Resistance raises the cap.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_COLD: Reduces Cold Damage taken by this percentage. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Cold Resistance raises the cap.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_LIGH: Reduces Lightning Damage taken by this percentage. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Lightning Resistance raises the cap.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_CHAO: Reduces Chaos Damage taken, including poison. Normally capped at 75%; Maximum Chaos Resistance raises the cap.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_ALL: Adds to Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistances at once.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ALL_RESISTA: Adds to Fire, Cold, Lightning and Chaos Resistances at once.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_: Raises the Fire Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
Raises the Cold Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
Raises the Lightning Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
Raises the Chaos Resistance cap above the base 75%, up to 90%.
Raises the Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistance caps above the base 75%, up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_BLOCK_MAX: Raises the Block chance cap above the base 50%, up to 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_EVASION_MAX: Raises the Evasion chance cap above the base 50%, up to 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PHYSICAL_RE: Raises the cap on physical damage reduction from Armour and reduction above the base 75%, up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_MA: Raises the Critical Strike chance cap above the base 70%, up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_PHYS: Physical damage of the hero's attacks. Reduced by the target's Armour and physical damage reduction.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_MAGI: Base damage of the hero's spells, scaled by skill and spell damage bonuses.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_FIRE: Fire Damage added to the hero's hits. Reduced by the target's Fire Resistance.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_COLD: Cold Damage added to the hero's hits. Reduced by the target's Cold Resistance.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_LIGH: Lightning Damage added to the hero's hits. Reduced by the target's Lightning Resistance.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_CHAO: Chaos Damage added to hits. Reduced by Chaos Resistance and bypasses Energy Shield.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ELEMENTAL_D: Increases Fire, Cold and Lightning Damage at once.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_DAMAGE: A «more damage» multiplier to all damage the hero deals. Increases to damage in general are not part of it: they add to the increases of each damage type.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SKILL_DAMAG: Increases the damage of the hero's skills; adds to the other damage increases.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SPELL_DAMAG: Increases damage of spells and their damage over time effects.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_DOT_TAKEN: Modifies damage over time taken, such as from burning, poison and bleeding.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_CH: Chance for an attack to land a critical strike for extra damage; spells have their own. Base 5%, capped at 70%; Maximum Critical Chance raises the cap up to 90%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_DA: The share of a critical strike's bonus over a normal hit, 100 at base: at 140 a 150% multiplier hits for 170%, at 0 a critical strike hits like a normal one.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_MU: How much stronger an attack's critical strike is than a normal hit; spells have their own. Base 150%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_VA: Share of critical strike damage returned to the hero as Life.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CRITICAL_TA: Increases the damage the target takes from critical strikes.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PENETRATE_F: Your damage ignores part of the target's Fire Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PENETRATE_C: Your damage ignores part of the target's Cold Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PENETRATE_L: Your damage ignores part of the target's Lightning Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PENETRATE_C: Your damage ignores part of the target's Chaos Resistance, possibly below zero.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PENETRATE_E: Your damage ignores part of the target's Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistances.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_A: Increases damage against enemies affected by any ailment, such as ignite, shock or poison.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ATTACK_SPEE: How many attacks per second the hero makes. More attacks mean more damage per second.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CAST_SPEED: Speeds up spellcasting, making spells recover faster.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_MOVEMENT_SP: How fast the hero moves around areas.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SKILL_PREPA: Shortens skill preparation as a fight opens, so skills are ready sooner. Up to 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_MANA_REGEN: Increases the rate of Mana regeneration.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_LEECH_PHYSI: Share of physical damage dealt returned to the hero as Life.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_LEECH_MANA: Share of damage dealt returned to the hero as Mana.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_LEECH_ALL: Share of all damage dealt returned to the hero as Life.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_HEALTH_ON_K: Life restored for each enemy killed.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_MANA_ON_KIL: Mana restored for each enemy killed.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_HEALTH_ON_H: Life restored for each weapon hit.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_MANA_ON_HIT: Mana restored for each weapon hit.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SKILL_COST: Reduces the Mana cost of skills.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RESERVATION: Auras reserve less Mana, leaving more for skills.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_LIFE_REGEN_: Percentage of maximum Life regenerated per second.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ENERGY_REGE: Percentage of maximum Energy Shield regenerated per second.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_IGNITE_CHAN: Chance on hit to Ignite: a burning enemy takes fire damage over time.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_FREEZE_CHAN: Chance on hit to Freeze: a frozen enemy cannot act.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SHOCK_CHANC: Chance on hit to Shock: a shocked enemy takes more damage.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_POISON_CHAN: Chance on hit to Poison: poison deals chaos damage over time.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_BLEED_CHANC: Chance on hit to cause Bleeding: the target takes physical damage over time.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_BURNING_DAM: Increases the damage of burning from your ignites.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_POISON_DAMA: Increases the damage of your poisons.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_BLEED_DAMAG: Increases the damage of bleeding you inflict.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_AVOID_ELEME: Chance to avoid being Ignited, Chilled, Frozen and Shocked.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_IGNITE_DURA: How much shorter Ignite lasts on you. Capped at 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CHILL_DURAT: How much shorter Chill lasts on you. Capped at 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_FREEZE_DURA: How much shorter Freeze lasts on you. Capped at 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SHOCK_DURAT: How much shorter Shock lasts on you. Capped at 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_POISON_DURA: How much shorter Poison lasts on you. Capped at 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_BLEED_DURAT: How much shorter Bleeding lasts on you. Capped at 75%.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_INVENTORY_S: How many items the hero's inventory can hold.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_GOLD: Increases the amount of gold gained from enemies and loot.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_EXPERIENCE: Increases experience gained by the hero.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RARITY: Raises the chance that dropped items are magic, rare or unique.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_QUANTITY: Increases the number of items dropped.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_LIGHT_RADIU: How far around the hero the area is lit during expeditions.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CHEST_QUANT: Increases the number of chests in areas.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_TAUNT: Taunts enemies, making them focus their attacks on the bearer.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_AILMENT_DUR: Increases the duration of all ailments you inflict.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_IGNITE_DURA: Increases the duration of Ignite you inflict.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CHILL_DURAT: Increases the duration of Chill you inflict.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_FREEZE_DURA: Increases the duration of Freeze you inflict.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SHOCK_DURAT: Increases the duration of Shock you inflict.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_POISON_DURA: Increases the duration of Poison you inflict.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_BLEED_DURAT: Increases the duration of Bleeding you inflict.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_DAMAGE_TAKE: Modifies all damage taken. A negative value means less damage.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_PHYSICAL_TA: Modifies physical damage taken. A negative value means less damage.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_ELEMENTAL_T: Modifies fire, cold and lightning damage taken. A negative value means less damage.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_CHAOS_TAKEN: Modifies chaos damage taken. A negative value means less damage.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_RECOVERY_RA: Speeds up Life and Energy Shield recovery: regeneration, leech, and life gained on hit and kill.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_THORNS: Damage dealt back to an enemy that hits you.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_REFLECT: Share of damage taken reflected back to the attacker.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_BLEED_TAKEN: Increases the effect of Bleeding applied to the target.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SHOCK_TAKEN: Increases the effect of Shock on the target, making it take even more damage.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_SHIELD_OF_L: Adds a percentage of maximum Life to Energy Shield.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_LOW_LIFE_SP: Increased attack speed while the bearer is on low Life.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_MANA_BURN: Each hit burns a percentage of the target's maximum Mana.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.STOCK_BORROW_SKIL: The bearer gains a borrowed monster skill and the Mana to cast it.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.AURA_RESIST: The bearer's aura lowers enemies' elemental and chaos resistances.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.AURA_DAMAGE_TAKEN: The bearer's aura increases the damage enemies take.
enum.EnumStatStockDesc.AURA_SLOW: The bearer's aura slows enemies' attacks.

guild.faction.WARDENS.name: Lighthouse Wardens
guild.faction.WARDENS.description: While the Lighthouse burns, the Abyss cannot find the shore. We feed the fire with what we took back from the dark.
guild.faction.HEEDING.name: The Heeding
guild.faction.HEEDING.description: The abbot heard it first. We listen to what the crystals sing, and write it down while we still understand the words.
guild.faction.DEEPBOUND.name: The Deepbound
guild.faction.DEEPBOUND.description: The Abyss called every exile here. We answered — and we descend where others flee.

quest.story.S1_LANDING.name: Washed Ashore
quest.story.S1_LANDING.description: Wake on the wet sand and clear the Tidal Shore: an exile's first steps.
quest.story.S1_WRECKS.name: Dead Ships
quest.story.S1_WRECKS.description: The drowned of the broken hulls bar the way. Lay 30 of them to rest in the Ship Graveyard.
quest.story.S1_LIGHT.name: The Dark Lighthouse
quest.story.S1_LIGHT.description: The lighthouse went silent when the sea took its keeper. Clear the Drowned Lighthouse.
quest.story.S1_SMUGGLERS.name: The Smugglers' Debt
quest.story.S1_SMUGGLERS.description: The smugglers know the path inland, but their chief will not give it away. Slay the guardian of the Smugglers' Grotto.
quest.story.S1_BARROW.name: The Chieftain's Barrow
quest.story.S1_BARROW.description: A chieftain who remembers the first exiles sleeps in the barrow. Clear the Chieftain's Barrow.
quest.story.S1_CRYPT.name: Crypt of the Exiled
quest.story.S1_CRYPT.description: Those who came before you found no rest. Slay the guardian of the Crypt of Exiles and open the way to the mountains.
quest.chapter.REGION_2: Chapter II. Voice of the Crystals
quest.story.S2_VILLAGE.name: The Miners' Village
quest.story.S2_VILLAGE.description: The miners left their homes for the mines. Clear the Miners' Village and learn why.
quest.story.S2_MINES.name: Singing Veins
quest.story.S2_MINES.description: The crystals whisper and the beasts of the mines go mad. Kill 6 magic monsters in the Crystal Mines.
quest.story.S2_TOOLS.name: The Master's Tools
quest.story.S2_TOOLS.description: The miners' smith will teach you to hear the crystals if you prove you can work orbs. Apply 5 orbs to items.
quest.story.S2_PASS.name: The Frozen Pass
quest.story.S2_PASS.description: The way to the peak runs through a pass where even screams freeze. Clear the Frozen Pass.
quest.story.S2_PEAK.name: Storm Peak
quest.story.S2_PEAK.description: Something that calls the storms waits on the summit. Slay the guardian of Storm Peak.
quest.story.S2_TEMPLE.name: The Drowned Temple
quest.story.S2_TEMPLE.description: The crystals sing for the one asleep beneath the temple's water. Slay the guardian of the Drowned Temple.
quest.chapter.REGION_3: Chapter III. The King Beneath the Sun
quest.story.S3_CARAVAN.name: The Caravan Road
quest.story.S3_CARAVAN.description: Caravans never reach the oasis. Clear the Caravan Road.
quest.story.S3_TRADE.name: The Price of Water
quest.story.S3_TRADE.description: In the sands, water is paid for with plunder. Sell 10 items to the merchant.
quest.story.S3_RAIDERS.name: The Raider Camp
quest.story.S3_RAIDERS.description: The raiders march under a dead king's banner. Kill 3 rare monsters in the Raider Camp.
quest.story.S3_TOMBS.name: Tombs of Kings
quest.story.S3_TOMBS.description: Every tomb is empty: the kings have risen. Clear the Tombs of Kings.
quest.story.S3_EMBALMER.name: The Embalmer
quest.story.S3_EMBALMER.description: The one who prepared the kings for eternity now prepares them for war. Slay the guardian of the Embalmers' Hall.
quest.story.S3_PYRAMID.name: Pyramid of the Sun King
quest.story.S3_PYRAMID.description: The Sun King waits atop his pyramid. Slay the guardian of the Sun King's Pyramid.
quest.chapter.REGION_4: Chapter IV. Heart of the Hive
quest.story.S4_EDGE.name: The Jungle's Edge
quest.story.S4_EDGE.description: The jungle grows as you watch and swallows the trails. Clear the Jungle's Edge.
quest.story.S4_EXPEDITION.name: The Lost Expedition
quest.story.S4_EXPEDITION.description: An expedition went for amber and never came back. Clear the Lost Expedition Camp.
quest.story.S4_BROOD.name: The Brood
quest.story.S4_BROOD.description: The hive breeds warriors faster than they die. Kill 80 monsters in the Brood Chambers.
quest.story.S4_CRAFT.name: Amber Gear
quest.story.S4_CRAFT.description: The hive's resin is stronger than steel for those who can work it. Make 2 items with a profession.
quest.story.S4_TREE.name: The Great Tree
quest.story.S4_TREE.description: The hive's roots have wrapped the Great Tree. Slay its guardian.
quest.story.S4_HIVE.name: Heart of the Hive
quest.story.S4_HIVE.description: The hive queen rules the wilds from its very heart. Slay the guardian of the Heart of the Hive.
quest.story.S5_FORT.name: The Frontier Fort
quest.story.S5_FORT.description: The frontier fort fell in a single night. Clear the Frontier Fort.
quest.story.S5_GENERAL.name: The Turncoat General
quest.story.S5_GENERAL.description: The fort was surrendered by its own general. Slay the guardian of the Frontier Fort.
quest.story.S5_LEVEL.name: Tempered
quest.story.S5_LEVEL.description: No one untempered by fire will survive the citadel walls. Reach level 55.
quest.story.S5_FORGES.name: The War Forges
quest.story.S5_FORGES.description: The forges arm a host for a final march. Kill 5 rare monsters in the War Forges.
quest.story.S5_GATE.name: The Infernal Gate
quest.story.S5_GATE.description: The citadel gate is kept by a flame with a name. Slay the guardian of the Infernal Gate.
quest.story.S5_CITADEL.name: The Flame Citadel
quest.story.S5_CITADEL.description: The lord of fire waits in the citadel's heart. Slay the guardian of the Citadel of Flame.
quest.story.S6_RIFT.name: The Rift's Edge
quest.story.S6_RIFT.description: The land is split, and cold breathes from the crack. Clear the Rift's Edge.
quest.story.S6_ABBEY.name: The Fallen Abbot
quest.story.S6_ABBEY.description: The abbot was first to hear the Abyss and first to answer. Slay the guardian of the Forsaken Abbey.
quest.story.S6_OSSUARY.name: The Ossuary
quest.story.S6_OSSUARY.description: The dead of the Abyss do not lie still. Kill 120 monsters in the Ossuary.
quest.story.S6_STAR.name: The Fallen Star
quest.story.S6_STAR.description: A star fell where the sky touches the Abyss. Clear the Fallen Star.
quest.story.S6_STAIR.name: The Endless Stair
quest.story.S6_STAIR.description: The stair leads down to the throne. Slay the guardian of the Endless Stair.
quest.story.S6_THRONE.name: The Abyssal Throne
quest.story.S6_THRONE.description: On the throne sits what called every exile here. Slay the guardian of the Throne of the Abyss.
quest.story.S7_1.name: Sky Landing
quest.story.S7_2.name: Mirror Flats
quest.story.S7_2.description: Slay the guardian of Mirror Flats.
quest.story.S7_3.name: Temple of Winds
quest.story.S7_3.description: Kill 140 monsters in Temple of Winds.
quest.story.S7_4.name: Cloud Citadel
quest.story.S7_5.name: Eye of the Storm
quest.story.S7_5.description: Slay the guardian of Eye of the Storm.
quest.story.S7_6.name: Throne of the Broken Sky
quest.story.S7_6.description: Slay the guardian of Throne of the Broken Sky.
quest.story.S8_1.name: Sunken Gate
quest.story.S8_2.name: Pearl Reef
quest.story.S8_2.description: Slay the guardian of Pearl Reef.
quest.story.S8_3.name: Legion Barracks
quest.story.S8_4.name: Sealed Cistern
quest.story.S8_5.name: Imperial Baths
quest.story.S8_5.description: Slay the guardian of Imperial Baths.
quest.story.S8_6.name: The Drowned Throne
quest.story.S8_6.description: Slay the guardian of The Drowned Throne.
quest.story.S9_1.name: Threshold of the Gods
quest.story.S9_2.name: Constellation Bridge
quest.story.S9_2.description: Slay the guardian of Constellation Bridge.
quest.story.S9_3.name: The Sunforge
quest.story.S9_4.name: Hollow Pantheon
quest.story.S9_5.name: Throne Road
quest.story.S9_5.description: Slay the guardian of Throne Road.
quest.story.S9_6.name: The Last Throne
quest.story.S9_6.description: Slay the guardian of The Last Throne.

item.UNVEILING_ORB.description: For an item or tool with a veiled modifier (dropped by rare monsters): offers three options, the chosen one takes the veiled slot.
item.CATALYST_LIFE.name: Vivid Catalyst
item.CATALYST_LIFE.description: An omen for the Orb of Quality: does nothing alone. An Orb of Quality used with it raises equipment quality (not flasks, maps or tools) by its rarity step, up to 20%, and each percent boosts life, regeneration and leech modifiers. Other quality is reset.

An Orb of Quality used with it raises equipment quality (not flasks, maps or tools) by its rarity step, up to 20%, and each percent boosts armour, evasion, energy shield and block modifiers. Other quality is reset.

item.CATALYST_ELEMENTAL.description: An omen for the Orb of Quality: does nothing alone. An Orb of Quality used with it raises equipment quality (not flasks, maps or tools) by its rarity step, up to 20%, and each percent boosts elemental damage and resistances modifiers. Other quality is reset.

item.OMEN_DEXTRAL_EXALTATION.description: An Exalted Orb used with it adds a suffix only.

item.OMEN_DEXTRAL_ANNULMENT.name: Omen of Dextral Annulment

equipment.RIMEWARD.name: Rimeward
equipment.SKYPIERCER.description: Lightning strikes it first, and it hands the bolt on.
equipment.SKYPIERCER.name: Skypiercer
equipment.PILGRIMS_BURDEN.description: A thousand miles of prayer worn into smooth wood.
equipment.PILGRIMS_BURDEN.name: Pilgrim's Burden
equipment.TIDEBINDER.description: Whoever holds it tells the sea when to turn.
equipment.TIDEBINDER.name: Tidebinder
equipment.WITCHWOOD_CROOK.description: Cut in a grove where no bird sings.
equipment.WITCHWOOD_CROOK.name: Witchwood Crook
equipment.PRISMSPIRE.description: Light goes in white and comes out as a weapon.
equipment.PRISMSPIRE.name: Prismspire
equipment.SEVENFOLD_SKY.description: Seven skies overhead, and a star in each.
equipment.SEVENFOLD_SKY.name: Sevenfold Sky
equipment.LICHBONE_STAFF.description: Its master died twice; the staff never did.
equipment.LICHBONE_STAFF.name: Lichbone Staff
equipment.WORLDTREE_BOUGH.description: The tree never missed it. The world did.
equipment.WORLDTREE_BOUGH.name: Worldtree Bough
equipment.VOIDSPIRE.description: It casts no shadow; the shadow casts it.
equipment.VOIDSPIRE.name: Voidspire
equipment.ARCHMAGES_BULWARK.description: It held against three schools of magic and one army.
equipment.ARCHMAGES_BULWARK.name: Archmage's Bulwark
equipment.CHIEFTAINS_EMBER.description: The tribe followed it for as long as it burned.
equipment.CHIEFTAINS_EMBER.name: Chieftain's Ember
equipment.GLACIAL_EDICT.description: The edict is read. Objections froze.
equipment.GLACIAL_EDICT.name: Glacial Edict
equipment.SUNBRAND.description: It marked those the sun had already chosen.
equipment.SUNBRAND.name: Sunbrand
equipment.STORMCROWN_SCEPTRE.description: Thunder comes when it is raised.
equipment.STORMCROWN_SCEPTRE.name: Stormcrown Sceptre
equipment.OATHBINDER.description: An oath sworn over it holds tighter than a chain.
equipment.OATHBINDER.name: Oathbinder
equipment.USURPERS_SCEPTRE.description: It is never inherited. It is taken.
equipment.USURPERS_SCEPTRE.name: Usurper's Sceptre
equipment.PENITENTS_ROD.description: Every blow is a line from someone else's confession.
equipment.PENITENTS_ROD.name: Penitent's Rod
equipment.TRIUNE_REGALIA.description: Fire, ice and storm swore to a single hand.
equipment.TRIUNE_REGALIA.name: Triune Regalia
equipment.PYRE_OF_KINGS.description: Nine crowns burned on it. It asks for a tenth.
equipment.PYRE_OF_KINGS.name: Pyre of Kings
equipment.IRON_MANDATE.description: A law forged on an anvil does not bend.
equipment.IRON_MANDATE.name: Iron Mandate
equipment.DAWNBRINGER.description: Where it is raised, the night ends early.
equipment.DAWNBRINGER.name: Dawnbringer
equipment.WORLDSPINE.description: Broken off the mountain the map is pinned to.
equipment.WORLDSPINE.name: Worldspine
equipment.GODKINGS_MANDATE.description: He ruled the sky and everyone beneath it.
equipment.GODKINGS_MANDATE.name: God-King's Mandate
equipment.TREASURE_DELVERS_HOOD.descript: A candle on the brow, a sack on the back and not one thought of the way home.
equipment.TREASURE_DELVERS_HOOD.name: Treasure-Delver's Hood
equipment.STONEWARDENS_HAUBERK.descripti: He never gave ground. Neither did the walls around him.
equipment.STONEWARDENS_HAUBERK.name: Stonewarden's Hauberk
equipment.BRAWLERS_ABANDON.description: Shields are for those who plan to see the morning.
equipment.BRAWLERS_ABANDON.name: Brawler's Abandon
equipment.DESERTERS_STRIDE.description: Through snow, through ice, through the oath.
equipment.DESERTERS_STRIDE.name: Deserter's Stride
equipment.TORTOISE_OATH.description: Draw in your head and outlive whoever came looking for it.
equipment.TORTOISE_OATH.name: Tortoise Oath
equipment.STORMHAWK_PINIONS.description: Lightning strikes the tallest thing. The hawk flies higher.
equipment.STORMHAWK_PINIONS.name: Stormhawk Pinions
equipment.SCARKNIT_CORD.description: Every scar on it was stitched by another hand and healed on its own.
equipment.SCARKNIT_CORD.name: Scarknit Cord
equipment.GIANTSLAYERS_TITHE.description: The giant takes his share first. This ring takes the second.
equipment.GIANTSLAYERS_TITHE.name: Giantslayer's Tithe
equipment.HOARFROST_SEAL.description: Whatever it touches remembers winter longer than it should.
equipment.HOARFROST_SEAL.name: Hoarfrost Seal
equipment.ORACLES_TALLY.description: She kept count of every true prophecy. The false ones she never wrote down.
equipment.ORACLES_TALLY.name: Oracle's Tally
equipment.GLASSCUTTERS_PENDANT.descripti: It cuts clean. It breaks the same way.
equipment.GLASSCUTTERS_PENDANT.name: Glasscutter's Pendant
equipment.THE_BARBED_HUNT.description: The arrow does not kill. It only keeps the quarry from leaving.
equipment.THE_BARBED_HUNT.name: The Barbed Hunt
equipment.SHARD_OF_ABANDON.description: Whoever holds it forgets where his back is.
equipment.SHARD_OF_ABANDON.name: Shard of Abandon
equipment.THE_FIRST_CUT.description: The first stroke decides the duel. The rest are for the crowd.
equipment.THE_FIRST_CUT.name: The First Cut
equipment.MERCYS_END.description: A narrow blade for those already begging for mercy.
equipment.MERCYS_END.name: Mercy's End
equipment.REAVERS_FERVOUR.description: The first blow is for the plunder. Every other is for the joy of it.
equipment.REAVERS_FERVOUR.name: Reaver's Fervour
equipment.FINAL_ARGUMENT.description: When the words run out, the axe does the talking.
equipment.FINAL_ARGUMENT.name: Final Argument
equipment.TAINTED_RAINBOW.description: Every colour of the sky, and one that has no place there.
equipment.TAINTED_RAINBOW.name: Tainted Rainbow
equipment.TEMPEST_NEEDLE.description: One spark, and the mightiest foe twitches like a puppet.
equipment.TEMPEST_NEEDLE.name: Tempest Needle
equipment.THE_SLOW_PYRE.description: It is in no hurry. Fire never is.
equipment.THE_SLOW_PYRE.name: The Slow Pyre
equipment.MARTYRS_SCEPTRE.description: His wounds closed faster than they could be dealt. Almost.
equipment.MARTYRS_SCEPTRE.name: Martyr's Sceptre
item.QUALITY_ORB.name: Orb of Quality
item.QUALITY_ORB.description: Raises quality: +5% on a normal item, +2% on a magic one, +1% on others, up to 20%. Weapons and armour — their base (damage, armour, evasion, energy shield); a flask — its quality; a profession tool — its work lines; a map — its item quantity; a pet — its lines. With a catalyst — that kind of quality on equipment (not flasks, maps or tools). Another kind of quality starts over.
item.OMEN_CHOICE.name: Omen of Choice
item.OMEN_CHOICE.description: An Orb of Alchemy or Exalted Orb used with it offers three options instead of a random line — on equipment, tools, maps and pets; the chosen one is added.
item.OMEN_TIER.name: Omen of Tiers
item.OMEN_TIER.description: A Divine Orb used with it raises tiers instead of rerolling values: one random affix on equipment and tools, every affix on a map (no higher than the item level).
